meta.title: A live RFQ with a vendor's bid: "Recreate Order": "Cancel" closes it and changes nothing
warnings: resolved: “Directly compare the event's bidding times before and after cancellation.” — remember + expect_remembered compare a value across elements, screens or portals (as numbers with as/delta); expect_api_value compares with the API

resolved: “Directly compare every event status field before and after cancellation.” — remember + expect_remembered compare a value across elements, screens or portals (as numbers with as/delta); expect_api_value compares with the API

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ summary as the buyer.
Open the RFQ stage requested by the case.
Verify before cancellation that the vendor's bid is present in the buyer's response view.
Record that the existing bid price is shown before opening Recreate Order.
Open the Recreate Order window from the RFQ Settings menu.
Verify that the Recreate Order window opened.
Verify that the Recreate Order window closed.
Verify that the vendor response and bid remain unchanged after cancellation.
Verify that the same bid price is still shown after cancellation.
Verify that cancellation did not leave an error or broken screen state.
